Frequently asked questions

Here are the answers to the most common questions.

How much do your services cost?

Full-service projects typically range between $2,750 - $15,000. Contact me for pricing on individual services.

Do you offer your services separately?

Yes. I can provide either just branding, web design or Webflow development services separately to fit around your existing strategy.

Can you transfer my Wordpress site over to Astrojs?

Yes. More and more businesses are realising that Astrojs is the future of building on the web, which is why I offer rebuilds of existing Wordpress websites in Astrojs website.

How can I get support?

Full-service projects typically range between $2,750 - $15,000. Contact me for pricing on individual services.

Can you help with my existing React/Astrojs project?

Yes. I offer both consulting and development services for clients with existing Webflow projects. Development: $249/week
